slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 大晋，并州。
晨曦未启，临安都督府旁停留了数辆马驾，宝辇富贵，车身明亮，更远处一帮散修百姓见此阵仗，痴痴停在原地。
“我嘞个乖乖！清河赵家、丘山王家，这可都是并州一等一的豪族啊！”
“怎么都聚集在此地啊，难道是要求见柳大人？”
“绝不是！柳大人虽然名震岭北数州，但也经不住这么多大族之长等候求见！”
“哼！看来那个传闻是真的了······”
“好哥哥，快说说！是何传闻？”
“听说帝京的那位北侯世子，已经入了并州，将访临安郡呢！”
话落，窃窃私语的众人齐齐呆住，心头兴起骇浪，魂飞至天外。
北侯……世子？
京城的那位世子爷？！
那可是放眼天下都是绝顶尊贵的主儿啊，能在皇后娘娘身边畅谈，能把各州州牧的脑袋当球踢的大人物。
其身世虽非皇家血脉，但在诸多人眼中，他的尊贵程度与紫禁宫那帮真正意义上的天潢贵胄也一般无二了。
那穿着貂皮裘的年轻人神情倨傲，见全场死寂，眼色不禁又得意三分。
“咱们并州都督柳大人，当年便是镇北侯麾下的大将之一，世子此来，大抵是替父探望旧部。”
原来如此！
众人了然，但心脏依旧跳个不停。
记忆里不断浮现出那位世子殿下的传闻。
北侯世子，裴苏，字九牧，传闻天生一道仙人印，乃真君转世，有仙人之姿。
其天赋亦是冠绝九州，年仅十九便修成玄元，大晋国师青霭通玄君曾言，九牧之姿，一甲子必入法象天人。
临安行道。
马蹄惊雷，七位肃杀的黑甲骑士骑着赤血马，其后牵引着一尊朱红车辇。
车身以凉州赤檀木为骨架，雕有云龙纹，辇前白绫马具嵌着西漠的异域翡翠。
车内，一个年轻人正在休憩。
其面如冠玉，气质矜贵非凡，最动人心魄的那双凤眸，眼尾微挑，配合白皙俊秀的面庞，任谁第一眼望见这俊美少年都能猜出其身世之天贵。
其旁尚站着位少女，身穿蓝白色玲珑裙摆，姿容亦是绝色。
肌肤白若细瓷，五官小巧精致，头发挽成高髻，戴了一枚白玉翡翠珠钗。
她望着矜贵的休憩少年，藏起倾慕之色，轻声道：
“世子殿下，临安州府要到了。”
其站位、语气、神色，赫然是侍女之位，只是其气质相貌，犹胜王公贵女。
裴苏缓缓睁开眼，掀开朱帘瞧着车辇外，眼神莫名幽深。
竟又梦到了前世，算算时间，穿越而来，也有了十九个年头......
前世，他不过是蓝星华国的普通人，一次意外，却一朝胎穿到了一方玄幻王朝的世界。
他所在的大晋王朝，九方龙气汇集，国祚昌隆，万邦来朝，强盛到了极点。
只不过昌盛国力的背后，是世家盘根错节，军政之柄世代相承，门阀根基之深动摇国之根本。
加之修行者存在，寒门之士更难往上攀爬，而氏族子弟却能世袭高位，看来即便是异世界玄幻王朝也无法改变这种状况。
不过裴苏并不在意，因为这一世他的出身，赫然是全天下最大的权贵门阀——
古世家裴家！
位列京城七阀之首，高高在上，俯瞰人间风云变幻，王朝兴衰。
树大根深，党羽众多，近些年来更是被江湖中的有心人取了个“裴半朝”的称呼讽刺其门生故吏遍布朝廷。
不仅如此，他父亲乃当朝威名最盛的镇国将军，二十年前被封镇北王侯，坐镇朔州天阙关。
祖父乃当朝相国，柱国公，正一品，金印紫绶，拜尚书省左仆射，位极人臣，权倾朝野。
作为大晋朝顶级世家裴家的嫡脉大公子，论及身份之尊贵，放眼人间也少有人能及！

Da Jin, Bingzhou.
Before dawn, several horse-drawn carriages were parked next to the Governor's Mansion in Lin'an. The chariots were rich and noble, and the carriages were bright. A group of casual cultivators further away saw this formation and stopped in place.
"Dear me! The Zhao family in Qinghe and the Wang family in Qiushan are both the first-class wealthy families in Bingzhou!"
"Why are they all gathered here? Are they asking to see Mr. Liu?"
"Absolutely not! Even though Mr. Liu is famous in several states north of the mountain range, he still can't bear the thought of having so many heads of big clans waiting to see him!"
"Hmph! It seems that the rumor is true..."
"Good brother, tell me quickly! What is the rumor?"
"I heard that the Northern Marquis Prince from the Imperial Capital has entered Bingzhou and will visit Lin'an County!"
After the words fell, everyone who was whispering was stunned, their hearts were filled with panic, and their souls flew to the sky.
Beihou...the Crown Prince?
The prince in the capital? !
He was an extremely noble master in the world, a big shot who could talk freely around the queen and could kick the heads of state shepherds from various states like balls.
Although he is not of royal blood, in the eyes of many people, his level of nobility is no different from that of the real nobles in the Forbidden Palace.
The young man in the mink fur looked arrogant. Seeing the silence in the audience, his eyes couldn't help but feel proud.
"Our Bingzhou Governor, Mr. Liu, was one of the generals under the command of Zhenbei Marquis. The prince is here to visit his old army for his father."
That’s it!
Everyone understood, but their hearts were still beating.
Rumors about His Highness the Crown Prince kept popping up in his memory.
The prince of Beihou, Pei Su, whose courtesy name is Jiumu, is said to be born with an immortal seal, and is the reincarnation of the true king, with the appearance of an immortal.
His talent is also unparalleled in all nine states, and he achieved Xuanyuan at the age of only nineteen. Qing Ai Tongxuanjun, the master of the Jin Dynasty, once said that with the posture of Jiu Mu, he will definitely enter the Dharma Xiang Celestial Being.
······
Lin'an Xingdao.
The horses' hooves thundered, and seven black-armored knights rode red-blooded horses, pulling a vermilion chariot behind them.
The body of the car is made of Liangzhou red sandalwood as the skeleton, carved with cloud and dragon patterns, and the white silk harness in front of the chariot is inlaid with exotic jadeite from the Western Desert.
In the car, a young man was taking a rest.
His face is like a crown jade, and his temperament is noble and noble. The most touching pair of phoenix eyes, slightly raised at the end of the eyes, combined with the fair and handsome face, anyone who sees this handsome young man for the first time can guess that he has a noble life experience.
Next to it stood a young girl, wearing a blue and white exquisite skirt, and her appearance was also stunning.
Her skin is as white as fine porcelain, her facial features are small and delicate, her hair is pulled into a high bun, and she wears a white jade hairpin.
She looked at the noble resting young man, hiding her admiration, and said softly:
"Your Highness, Lin'an Prefecture is coming."
Her stance, tone, and expression are clearly that of a maid, but her temperament and appearance are even better than those of a prince's noble daughter.
Pei Su slowly opened his eyes, lifted the red curtain and looked outside the carriage, his eyes inexplicably deep.
I actually dreamed about my previous life again. I counted the time and found that it was nineteen years since I traveled through time...
In his previous life, he was just an ordinary person in the Blue Star Kingdom. By an accident, he was transported into the world of a fantasy dynasty.
The Jin dynasty he belonged to had the dragon energy from all directions gathered together, the country was prosperous, and all the nations came to the dynasty, and it became extremely powerful.
However, behind the prosperous national power, there are intertwined aristocratic families, the military and political power has been passed down from generation to generation, and the deep foundation of the clans has shaken the foundation of the country.
Coupled with the existence of cultivators, it is more difficult for people from poor families to climb up, but the children of clans can inherit high positions. It seems that even a fantasy dynasty from another world cannot change this situation.
But Pei Su didn't care, because in this life, he was the largest powerful man in the world——
The Pei family, an ancient family!
Ranking at the head of the seven lords in the capital, he is high up, overlooking the changing world and the rise and fall of dynasties.
The tree is big and has deep roots, and has many party members. In recent years, he has been nicknamed "Pei Banchao" by interested people in the world to ridicule that his disciples and former officials are all over the court.
Not only that, his father was the most prestigious general in the country at that time. Twenty years ago, he was granted the title of Prince of the North and sat in command of Tianque Pass in Shuozhou.
My grandfather was the prime minister of the dynasty, the Duke of Zhuguo, a first-rank official, with a gold seal and a purple ribbon. He was worshiped by Zuopushe, the Minister of Public Affairs.
As the eldest son of the Pei family, the top aristocratic family in the Jin Dynasty, few people in the world can match his noble status!
